negative_reviews.author: Joshua Stapleton
negative_reviews.text: Birthday booking for the bottomless on a Saturday afternoon, but did not have half the drinks menu and no substitutes. No solution offered during bottomless or when paying because it was a “Set menu”. Slow on drinks or would say not available well after ordering, overall not value for money. Food was nice however and staff were friendly! But probably not recommend bottomless when cisiting.
